call_points.text: Management maintains a normal annual standalone AUM growth guidance of around 15% for the first quarter.
Borrowing costs are expected to trend upwards, leading management to maintain yields at current levels.
The company plans to open 200-300 new branches for Muthoot Finance and around 200 gold branches for Belstar in the next year.
No numeric FY27 guidance is given; the presentation is a results recap with no forward targets.
Standalone NIM was 12.75% for FY26 versus 11.45% a year earlier; Q4FY26 NIM was 13.38%.

timeline.summary: George Alexander Muthoot, Promoter of Muthoot Finance Limited, declared no encumbrances on held shares during FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Muthoot Finance reported FY26 consolidated PAT of ₹10,607 Cr (+98% YoY) and loan AUM of ₹181,916 Cr (+49% YoY).
Muthoot Finance's Q4 & FY26 investor presentation recapped consolidated PAT of ₹10,607 Cr (+98% YoY) on loan AUM of ₹1,81,916 Cr (+49%), with Stage III assets at 2.35% and capital gearing of 3.46.
Muthoot Finance Limited uploaded the audio recording of its May 14, 2026 analyst call on its website at 08:00 PM.
Muthoot Finance Limited’s shareholders approved the Memorandum of Association’s Object Clause alteration via e-voting on May 16, 2026, with 93.27% favor.
On May 20, 2026, Muthoot Finance uploaded the transcript of its Q4 FY26 analyst call discussing record financial results and AUM growth.
